Fellowships and funding opportunities
Fellowships and funding opportunities
The Graduate School has resources for ways to fund your graduate education. Details can be found on their website.
For all opportunities listed below, please check the official website for official open and close dates.
Know of other fellowships? E-mail [email protected] to have it added to this list.
Expand all
+
3M Science and Technology Fellowships
How do you apply: Offered to new Ph.D. students as part of their admission funding package. Faculty nominate students for these awards. Typically CS&E receives two awards annually.
Opens: N/A
Closes/Due Date: N/A
+
ACM Doctoral Dissertation Award
How do you apply: Two nominations can be made by the department annually; only a Ph.D. student’s advisor may nominate a dissertation
Opens: Start of September
Closes/Due Date: End of October
Main Program Link

Interdisciplinary Doctoral Fellowship
How do you apply: Students must submit materials to their center or institute for nomination approval. Once reviewed and approved required documentation, including letters, should be submitted to the department (form will be sent out to collect information) well in advance of the Graduate School deadline. Programs are not limited in the number of nominations they may submit, however, only one nomination per student is allowed.
Opens: Start of September
Closes/Due Date: Early November (internal deadline for nominations)

Microsoft Fellowships (Ada Lovelace Fellowship & The Microsoft Research Ph.D. Fellowship)
How do you apply: Students must be nominated by the department; we may only nominate up to three students for the Ada Lovelace Fellowship; we can nominate up to three students as long as one self-identifies from an underrepresented group listed in the Ada Lovelace Fellowship requirements. Otherwise the department can only nominate two students.
Opens: Early July
Closes/Due Date: Early August (internal deadline for nominations)
